purpose: W8-A: replace the generic post-registration role-root interception with server-backed capability-specific activation and primary-action surfaces while preserving role/tenant authority and without modifying registration.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: Registration/auth/Role Eligibility are invariant and must not change. Workspace reads only the already verified current user/membership/capabilities.
Existing role workspaces remain canonical children; the first slice fixes shell interception/activation rather than rewriting every role page at once.
Controlled owner preview remains test-only and cannot become ordinary-user activation authority.
First contract may use an existing mounted aggregation/proxy boundary or separately accepted module wiring; global module changes are not required in the staged scope.

requiredInvariants: Registration behavior and role assignment are unchanged. The shell consumes only the server-verified role and current server-backed capability/workspace data.
Ordinary authenticated users are never routed to a test/owner preview and the preview cookie/controlled organization marker never grants product authority.

Every role root exposes one clear first primary action derived from current organization capability, authoritative workflow availability and current blockers; the browser cannot select or manufacture capability availability.
An empty role root is actionable: it explains why there is no work and offers only currently authorized creation/discovery/setup actions, not a dead message that waits for a Deal to appear.
Existing real role workspace children remain reachable and are not hidden behind a generic Deal-only dashboard when the user has a valid primary action unrelated to an existing Deal.

Role activation supports buyer, seller, logistics, driver, surveyor, elevator, lab, bank, compliance, arbitrator, executive and operator using one server-derived contract with role-specific action vocabulary.
Actions remain links/intents until the target server command independently authorizes them. UI activation state never becomes command authority.
Loading, empty, error, blocked and ready states are explicit and preserve RU/EN/ZH. Failures do not fall back to fabricated fixture work or test data.
Capability/setup blockers expose the exact next step, such as add organization capability, connect an accepted provider or complete required setup, only when that route/action is actually authorized.
No role root claims live external provider, signature, regulatory or money readiness unless the server workspace contract has accepted evidence for it.
Mobile-first first action is visible without horizontal scroll or hidden navigation; keyboard/focus and reduced-motion rules remain intact.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, product authorities and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Unit tests prove every role maps server workspace facts to an explicit primary action or an actionable blocked/empty state and never to invented work.
Regression proves ordinary role roots no longer replace their real workspace with a Deal-only generic surface by default.
Controlled owner preview remains presentation-only and cannot change current role/capabilities/tenant or server action authorization.
A role with zero Deals but permission to create/request work sees the relevant first action; a role without that permission sees an exact blocker/next step.
Server failure renders a recoverable error and never static/demo data.
E2E covers all role roots on at least 390px mobile and desktop with keyboard navigation and RU/EN/ZH labels for the primary activation state.
Registration boundary tests remain green and no auth/registration/eligibility file changes in the implementation diff.
Exact-head CI/review plus real-user acceptance later remain required before terminal role-activation credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Each downstream primary action must have its own accepted server authority before the UI can be terminally useful.
Full Deal 360 and settings/discovery UX remain separate W8 slices.
5–8 unaided real-user tasks per role remain ACCEPT-01 and are not proven by automated activation tests.
